title: MM Vanilla Tweaked
description: MM Vanilla Tweaked is a Vanilla-focused Fabric modpack designed to enhance performance, UI clarity, building tools, and overall quality-of-life without changing core Minecraft gameplay.
body:
This is a carefully curated, Vanilla-focused Fabric modpack, primarily created for the **Masala Mobsters** friend group, but publicly available for anyone who wants a smoother, more informative, and more comfortable Minecraft experience, without changing core Vanilla gameplay.

**MM Vanilla Tweaked** stays true to Minecraft’s original mechanics while layering in performance optimizations, UI clarity, building utilities, and subtle visual polish. No new blocks, items, or progression systems. Just Vanilla, refined.

Icon by [syr_sysel](https://makerworld.com/en/models/1812325-minecraft-running-copper-golem#profileId-1933627)!

---

# **What This Modpack Does**

MM Vanilla Tweaked enhances Minecraft by improving:

• Performance and stability  
• Inventory and UI clarity  
• Building precision and planning  
• Multiplayer quality-of-life  
• Visual smoothness and immersion  

All while preserving **pure Vanilla gameplay balance**.

---

## **Performance & Stability Enhancements**

These mods focus on smoother gameplay, higher FPS, and better server/client behavior:

* **Sodium** + **Sodium Extra** + **Reese’s Sodium Options** – Modern rendering performance
* **Lithium** – Game logic optimizations
* **ImmediatelyFast** – UI and rendering speedups
* **Entity Culling** + **More Culling** – Smarter entity rendering
* **Async** + **Alternate Current** – Redstone and network optimizations
* **Dynamic FPS** – Reduced system load when tabbed out
* **Packet Fixer** + **XL Packets** – Network stability improvements
* **Servux** – Client/server communication optimizations

These changes significantly improve performance without affecting Vanilla mechanics.

---

## **Interface, HUD & Information Improvements**

Mods that make Minecraft clearer and easier to understand:

* **Jade** – Block, entity, and item information at a glance
* **AppleSkin** – Hunger and saturation visualization
* **Enchantment Descriptions** – Clear enchantment explanations
* **Pick Up Notifier** – See what items you collect
* **Chat Heads** – Player heads in chat
* **More Chat History** – Extended chat logs
* **Dynamic Crosshair** – Context-aware crosshair behavior
* **Controlling** – Improved keybind management
* **ClientSort** – Cleaner inventory and mod organization

---

## **Inventory, Storage & Interaction QoL**

Reduce friction and tedious management:

* **Mouse Tweaks** – Faster inventory interactions
* **Stack to Nearby Chests** – Quick item organization
* **Chest Tracker** – See container contents at a glance
* **Searchables** – Better search support across GUIs
* **ClickThrough Plus** + **Cut Through** – Easier block interaction

---

## **Building & World Utilities**

Tools designed for builders, planners, and SMP worlds:

* **Litematica** + **Malilib** – Blueprinting and structure planning
* **MiniHUD** – Custom overlays and world data
* **Tweakeroo** – Precision building tweaks
* **WorldEdit** – Advanced building tools
* **Xaero’s Minimap** + **Xaero’s World Map** – Clean, reliable mapping

These tools are client-side friendly and ideal for survival or creative play.

---

## **Visual & Immersion Enhancements**

Lightweight visual upgrades that keep Minecraft feeling Vanilla:

* **Continuity** – Connected textures
* **LambDynamicLights** + **ScalableLux** – Dynamic lighting
* **Iris** – Shader support (optional)
* **Entity Model Features** + **Entity Texture Features** – Improved entity visuals
* **3D Skin Layers** – Enhanced player skins
* **Zoomify** – Smooth zoom functionality

---

## **Multiplayer & Social Features**

* **Simple Voice Chat** – Proximity voice chat for SMPs
* **Placeholder API** – UI integration support
* **Resourcify** – Easier resource pack handling

---

# **Purpose of This Pack**

MM Vanilla Tweaked is designed for:

* Small private SMPs and friend groups
* Players who want a **true Vanilla+ experience**
* Builders who need precision tools without gameplay changes
* Anyone seeking better performance and UI clarity without mods that alter progression

---

# **Disclosure / Derivative Notice**

This is an **unofficial, community-curated modpack**.
It is **not endorsed by Mojang, Fabric, or any mod authors**.
All mods belong to their respective creators.

This pack is primarily intended for **private group use**, but is publicly available for anyone who wants a refined Vanilla experience.
